SocialMinds releases a ROS 2 Lyrical stack for Reachy Mini

The stack supports ROS4HRI and can coexist with the original SDK, with users selecting which service runs.

Open Robotics Discourse / SocialMinds ↗19 November 2026English editorial summary
Story

The new development

SocialMinds researcher Séverin Lemaignan shared a ROS 2 stack for Reachy Mini on November 19 after testing and adopting it in the laboratory. It combines ROS 2 Lyrical with zenoh and provides public source code and installation instructions, enabling researchers to connect the robot to their own systems.

Technology and applications

A deb package pulls and updates a Lyrical Docker image. It can be installed alongside Pollen’s SDK, with users enabling or disabling the relevant systemd service. The drivers replace the supplied daemon and support ROS4HRI for human–robot interaction development.

Scope and next steps

The developer reports hardware-compressed Full HD video at 30 frames per second over Wi-Fi, plus real-time speech recognition and synthesis on the robot’s Raspberry Pi 4. These are developer-reported capabilities, not independent latency benchmarks across all networks. The announced distribution support specifically concerns Lyrical.
